description: Use when the user asks for an EU or national law by title, topic, abbreviation or number and needs the official text or link. Find EU or national legislation by title words, abbreviation or number in one call. Returns compact items with stable id, official links (EUR-Lex/ELI/CELEX or the national official portal), title, date, source, source_url and retrieved_at. Every item has status (in_force | repealed | unknown; in_force only when the official source says so), consolidated_url (current consolidated text, or null when the source has none), checked_at (date the status was read) and status_source. Popular names and abbreviations resolve to the right act (GDPR/DSGVO/RGPD, AI Act, NIS2, DORA, DSA, DMA, eIDAS, MiCA, CSRD, Data Act and more); English topic words such as 'company law' or 'GmbH law' map to the national acts (DE GmbHG/AktG/HGB, ES Ley de Sociedades de Capital, EE äriseadustik, FR Code de commerce). Country accepts codes or names in any language (DE, Germany, Deutschland). Search: EU (CELLAR, 24 languages via lang) and DE, EE, ES, AT, NL, PL, DK, LU, SE, IE, IT, LT, FI, CZ, HR, LV, SI, FR, GB. France (Légifrance): codes and consolidated laws by title or number (e.g. '78-17'), article text by '<code> article <n>' (e.g. 'Code civil article 1240'), and French case law (JUDILIBRE, Cour de cassation) with a 'juri:' prefix (e.g. 'juri:clause de non-concurrence'). United Kingdom (country=GB or UK): Acts and statutory instruments from legislation.gov.uk by title (e.g. 'Companies Act 2006'), Open Government Licence. Other EU Member States: returns the official portal, its search link and ELI pattern (link_only). Free, read-only, no API key during beta. No legal advice.

country.description: EU (default), or an EU Member State code or name in any language (DE, Germany, Deutschland, España). GB (or UK): UK legislation from legislation.gov.uk. US and other non-EU countries return the official portals. Search: EU, DE, EE, ES, AT, NL, PL, DK, LU, SE, IE, IT, LT, FI, CZ, HR, LV, SI, FR, GB; all 27 Member States return at least official portal links.

in_force_only.description: Default true (EU, ES). EE results are always the acts in force today.

lang.description: EU only: two-letter language of the title and EUR-Lex link, default en.

query.description: Title words, abbreviation or number, e.g. 'general data protection', '2016/679', 'GmbHG', 'Äriseadustik', 'sociedades de capital'.

name: find_law
